index.note: Flow opens the room: a 400-square-foot primary bath in the same house as the kitchen, then three chapters that are also the section titles (the vanities, the three marbles, the antique valet stand and the old painting), each opening to three specifics; the closing is the morning.
index.stand: The primary bath is 400 square feet, in the same Hill Country house as the kitchen. | It has two vanities, a freestanding tub under the window and a marble shower with a bench.

Her vanity faces the east windows.t: Vessel sinks sit under wall-mounted bridge faucets with cross handles,
Her vanity faces the east windows.g: a vintage shape on modern plumbing
li: The cabinet color | a lighter gray green, two steps from the kitchen's sage in the same paint family.
Upper cabinets | glass fronts on one side for display and solid doors on the other for storage.
The sconces | globe sconces at both vanities throw warm circles on the shiplap behind them.

Picking the marble took the longest.t: Three marbles were picked to go together,

p: Picking the marble took the longest.
li: The counters | Calacatta that runs warm with gold and brown veining.
The shower walls | cooler, with gray movement.
The shower floor | a hex mosaic for grip that splits the difference, and the same hex tile lines the recessed niche.
